name: financy
description: Financy - aplicação fullstack de gerenciamento de finanças. Backend e frontend são projetos independentes; estes scripts são apenas atalhos para rodar os dois juntos.

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.setup: pnpm run install:all && pnpm -C backend db:setup
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; pnpm -C backend dev & pnpm -C frontend dev & wait
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint
